decision_notes: The council website designates its YouTube service. Selected recordings of 109th regular session, Education/Safety Committee third meeting and Operations Committee third meeting were visually reviewed in Chromium and WebKit with advancing decoded video and the respective committee chairs conducting business. Long opening and recess sections were retained as separate non-confirming samples: Education/Safety at5400seconds and Operations at3900seconds show committee business. No plenary, current-live or full committee/room coverage is inferred.

Official council website link only. Its own site designates the video provider. No current, separate audiovisual reuse permission was established by the reviewed institutional/video navigation and search. Retain permission pending and do not embed, rehost or export provider streams.
